name: Oluwasegun Dada
headline: Product Marketing Manager | GTM Strategy | AI-Powered Growth | Developer Marketing | Customer Education | Ex-clients: Google and Microsoft

sections.bio:
Most products don't fail because they're bad.
 
They fail because people never truly understand why they matter.
 
That's the problem I've spent my career solving.
 
Across fintech, AI, and VR gaming, I've worked at the intersection of Product Marketing, Customer Success, Growth, and Go-to-Market Strategy—helping companies launch products, educate users, activate communities, and translate complex technology into clear, customer-centric stories.
 
I've contributed to:
 • Product launches and GTM strategies
 • Developer marketing and technical content
 • Customer onboarding and product adoption
 • Community-led growth initiatives
 • Creator and influencer programs
 • Voice of Customer feedback loops
 • Product positioning and messaging
 • Cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing
 
I'm also an AI-native marketer who incorporates tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Fireflies, NotebookLM, Cursor, and Lovable into research, competitive analysis, messaging development, documentation, and workflow automation—always validating outputs with product knowledge and customer insights.
 
What excites me most is helping companies bridge the gap between what they build and what customers actually understand.
 
I'm currently exploring Product Marketing opportunities with AI, SaaS, and developer-first companies building products that shape the future of work.
